title: Core idempotent decomposition
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings, with S an étale R-algebra [def-weil-etale-morphism], and let s:S→R be an R-algebra homomorphism. There is an idempotent e in S such that s(e)=1 and ker(s)=(1-e)S. The corner C=(1-e)S, with identity 1-e and R-algebra map r↦(1-e)algebraMap(r), admits an R-algebra equivalence S≅R×C whose first projection is s.

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 09XI (lemma-characterize-henselian-pair), (5)$\Rightarrow$(2), first paragraph: 'the surjective ring map $A'/IA'\to A/I$ is etale by Algebra, Lemma 00U7 (lemma-map-between-etale) and then we get the desired idempotent by Algebra, Lemma 00U8 (lemma-surjective-flat-finitely-presented)' (literature/stacks-project/algebra.tex); used without comment in the proof of Lemma Tag 0A02 (lemma-henselization): '$B'/IB'=A/I\times C$'

proof.text:
Proof: The section is surjective: r is the image of the structure-map value of r.
Its kernel is finitely generated by finite presentation of both R-algebras. Give R
its S-algebra structure through s. The algebra-homomorphism scalar tower and formal
étale cancellation show that R is formally étale over S. For a surjective formally
étale map, the kernel is an idempotent ideal. The finitely generated idempotent ideal
criterion supplies f with f*f=f and ker(s)=(f). Set e=1-f. Then e is idempotent,
s(f)=0, s(e)=1, and ker(s)=(1-e).

Put C=f.Corner and q(x)=f*x. Since f is a central idempotent, q is a unital ring
homomorphism into C, whose unit is f. Give C its R-algebra structure by q composed
with the structure map R to S. Thus its algebra map is r ↦ f*algebraMap R S r.
The R-algebra map Φ(x)=(s(x),q(x)) is injective: a difference z in its kernel lies
in (f), hence f*z=z, whereas its second coordinate gives f*z=0. It is surjective:
for (r,y) take e*algebraMap R S r+y. Corner membership gives f*y=y, so s(y)=0;
f*e=0 and s(e)=1 give precisely the two required coordinates. Taking the algebra
equivalence of this bijective map proves the claim, with first projection s.

lean.statement: theorem exists_idempotent_core {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.Etale R S] (s : S →ₐ[R] R) : ∃ (e : S) (he : IsIdempotentElem e), s e = 1 ∧ RingHom.ker s.toRingHom = Ideal.span {1 - e} ∧ (∃ (_ : Algebra R he.one_sub.Corner), (∀ r : R, (algebraMap R he.one_sub.Corner r).1 = (1 - e) * algebraMap R S r) ∧ ∃ Φ : S ≃ₐ[R] R × he.one_sub.Corner, ∀ x : S, (Φ x).1 = s x)
